vite:css
transforms.result: :root{--page--side-padding:3rem;--scrollbar-track-color:#fff;--scrollbar-thumb-color:#0691ff;--scrollbar-thumb-hover-color:#3fa8ff;--twinkle-duration:4s;--border-radius:8px}@media screen and (max-width:1440px){:root{--page--side-padding:2rem}}@media screen and (max-width:960px){:root{--page--side-padding:1rem}}.app-modal{align-items:center;background-color:rgba(0,0,0,.035);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;justify-content:center;left:0;position:fixed;top:0;width:100%;z-index:10}.app-modal__wrapper{overflow:hidden;position:relative}@media screen and (max-width:460px){.app-modal__wrapper{width:100%}}.app-modal__inner{background-color:#fff;border-radius:8px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;max-width:980px;min-width:720px;padding:16px}@media screen and (max-width:780px){.app-modal__inner{min-width:420px}}@media screen and (max-width:460px){.app-modal__inner{min-width:100%;padding:24px 0 0}}.app-modal__close-button{background-color:transparent;border:none;font-size:24px;position:absolute;right:16px;top:8px}@media screen and (max-width:460px){.app-modal__close-button{min-width:100%}}.app-modal__content{margin-top:24px}
